CONSTANTS.Symbols: Set of symbols used as erasure coding shares

SymbolOf.description: Canonical mapping assigning each node its unique RS share symbol
SymbolOf.instance: SymbolOf == CHOOSE f \in [P -> Symbols] : \A p, q \in P : (p # q) => (f[p] # f[q])

Decode.description: Abstracted interpolation decoding function mapping a set of shares and a root to a payload
Decode.instance: Decode(ShardSet, r) == IF r \in GoodRoots THEN "M_Good" ELSE IF SymbolOf[CHOOSE p \in Correct : TRUE] \in ShardSet THEN "M_Bad_1" ELSE "M_Bad_2"

sender.init: sender ∈ Faulty (hardcoded for adversarial testing in the current Init)

receivedS.description: Mapping Correct -> Roots ∪ {""}; root value received from the sender
receivedS.init: If sender ∈ Correct, maps to a chosen v ∈ GoodRoots; else unconstrained in Roots ∪ {""}

receivedE.description: receivedE[p] is the set of ECHO messages <<src, root, shard>> received by node p

receivedR.description: receivedR[p] is the set of READY messages <<src, root>> received by node p

delivered.description: Each correct node's decision output from Payloads

ACTIONS.name: ReceiveValAndEcho(self)
condition: No prior ECHO message sent by self for receivedS[self]
effect: Let r = receivedS[self] and myShard = SymbolOf[self]
For all p ∈ Correct: receivedE'[p] = receivedE[p] ∪ {<<self, r, myShard>>}

ACTIONS.name: ReceiveEchoAndReady(self)
condition: ∃ r ∈ Roots for which self hasn't sent READY
Cardinality(validEchos) ≥ N - F for root r
effect: For all p ∈ Correct: receivedR'[p] = receivedR[p] ∪ {<<self, r>>}

ACTIONS.name: AmplifyReady(self)
condition: ∃ r ∈ Roots for which self hasn't sent READY
effect: For all p ∈ Correct: receivedR'[p] = receivedR[p] ∪ {<<self, r>>}

ACTIONS.name: TryDecode(self)
condition: ∃ r ∈ Roots with ≥ 2F + 1 READYs and ≥ N - 2F valid ECHOs

ACTIONS.name: ByzantineEcho(self)
effect: Choose d ∈ Correct and r ∈ Roots

ACTIONS.name: ByzantineReady(self)
effect: Choose d ∈ Correct and r ∈ Roots

ACTIONS.name: Next
ACTIONS.formula: Disjunction of all enabled actions for correct and faulty nodes

ACTIONS.name: Spec
ACTIONS.description: Full system specification with weak fairness for honest actions.

INVARIANTS.name: TypeInv
INVARIANTS.spec_instance: sender ∈ P ∧ receivedS ∈ [Correct → Roots ∪ {""}] ∧ receivedE ∈ [Correct → SUBSET (P × Roots × Symbols)] ∧ receivedR ∈ [Correct → SUBSET (P × Roots)] ∧ delivered ∈ [Correct → Payloads]

INVARIANTS.name: Consistency
INVARIANTS.description: No two honest nodes decide different values
INVARIANTS.spec_instance: ∀ p, q ∈ Correct : (delivered[p] ≠ "" ∧ delivered[q] ≠ "") ⇒ delivered[p] = delivered[q]

PROPERTIES.name: Validity
PROPERTIES.description: If the sender is correct, all correct nodes eventually decide M_Good

PROPERTIES.name: Totality
PROPERTIES.description: If some correct process decides, eventually all correct processes decide
PROPERTIES.spec_instance: (∃ p ∈ Correct : delivered[p] ≠ "") ~> (∀ p ∈ Correct : delivered[p] ≠ "")

llm_hint.merkle_root_abstraction: GoodRoots and BadRoots abstract the Merkle tree validation. r ∈ GoodRoots in ReceiveEchoAndReady simulates the successful h' == h branch interpolation check.
llm_hint.erasure_coding_abstraction: Valid ECHOs must carry the expected SymbolOf[sender]. Decode() abstracts polynomial interpolation by mapping the shard subset to predefined Payloads.
llm_hint.state_space_optimization: Message sets receivedE and receivedR use Correct nodes as their domain to reduce state space, and record tuples instead of complex nested mappings.
